title: Agent Quickstart — Create a Payment Intent
description: Minimal instructions for an AI agent to create payment intents (transfers and Polymarket trades) using a JSON credential file.

credentialFile.description: JSON credential file generated when the human owner registers your agent from the web UI.
credentialFile.security: Never commit this file. The privateKey field is a secret.

parts.timestamp: Current Unix epoch in seconds as a string. Must be within 5 minutes of server time.
parts.bodyHash: keccak256(toHex(rawJsonBody)) as in viem — 0x-prefixed hex. For GET requests use the literal string '0x'. Do NOT use cast keccak; it does not match the server.
parts.signature: EIP-191 personal_sign of '<timestamp>.<bodyHash>' using the agent's privateKey. Must be 0x-prefixed.

authentication.bodyHashing: The bodyHash is computed over the exact bytes sent in the request body. Use compact JSON (no extra whitespace) to ensure a deterministic hash.
authentication.shellHelper: From repo root: node apps/web/scripts/agent-auth-header.mjs post '<json>' <credential.json> or ... get <credential.json> — outputs full Authorization value.

createTransferIntent.nextStep: Share the paymentUrl with the human so they can review and sign the transaction.

searchPolymarketMarkets.description: Search for active Polymarket markets by keyword. No authentication required. Use this to find the conditionId before creating a polymarket_trade intent.

createPolymarketIntent.description: Create a Polymarket trade intent. The backend enriches it with marketTitle, outcomePrice, and tokenId from the Polymarket CLOB API.

conditionId.description: Polymarket condition ID from search endpoint

memo.description: Agent's justification for the trade (shown to the human)

createPolymarketIntent.nextStep: Share the paymentUrl with the human so they can review the trade and sign with their Ledger.

pollForCompletion.description: Poll until status is one of the terminal states. For polymarket_trade intents, 'authorized' means the user signed the order. For transfer intents, 'confirmed' means on-chain confirmation.

docMirrorHosting.description: If serving this doc on a public host (e.g. doc_ethcc.vibecallin.com): enable TLS, redirect HTTP to HTTPS, add HSTS after validation, serve agent-context.json as application/json.

troubleshooting.cause: Used cast keccak or wrong body hash algorithm
troubleshooting.fix: Use viem keccak256(toHex(body)) or node apps/web/scripts/agent-auth-header.mjs — not cast keccak

troubleshooting.cause: Signature or body hash is malformed
troubleshooting.fix: Ensure bodyHash and signature are 0x-prefixed hex strings
Ensure your system clock is accurate (within 5 minutes of server time)
Ensure you hash the exact bytes sent as the request body (compact JSON, no trailing newline)
Use the search endpoint (GET /api/polymarket/markets?q=...) to find valid condition IDs
Search for a different active market
